name: ah-sentry-rca
description: Sentry issue root-cause analysis, read-only until a fix is requested. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

steps.prompt: Read Sentry issue {{sentry_issue}} in full, including one complete event with all fields, before interpreting it. Find the code path in {{repository}}. Do not edit files. State which cause is confirmed by data and label the rest unverified. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

From {{previous.output}}, write the root cause, the evidence field and value for each claim, and a proposed minimal fix. If a fix is wanted, hand off to ah-issue-to-draft-pr; do not change code here. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.
